google_play_store.full_description:
Master chess tactics and improve your game with Chess Tactics Master!

✨ FEATURES

🎯 Tactical Puzzles
Solve 1000+ puzzles ranging from beginner to advanced levels. Improve your tactical vision and decision-making skills with our comprehensive puzzle library.

🤖 CPU Opponents
Challenge AI opponents at multiple difficulty levels. From beginner to expert difficulty, find the right challenge for you.

🌍 Online Multiplayer
Play real-time chess matches against players worldwide. Our dynamic ELO rating system ensures fair matchmaking. Climb the global leaderboards and prove your skill!

📊 Rating System
Track your progress with our comprehensive ELO rating system. See how you stack up against other players globally and watch your rating improve.

📱 Complete Customization
• Multiple board themes (default, wooden, marble)
• Piece style options (default, wooden, classic)
• Light and dark mode support
• Adjustable board size
• Board coordinate display

🔔 Real-time Notifications
Get instant updates on:
• Match invitations from other players
• Game turns in active matches
• Game completion notifications
• Achievement unlocks
• Rating changes

⭐ Premium Subscription
Unlock premium features:
• Unlimited puzzle access
• Custom board themes
• Advanced game analysis
• Ad-free experience
• Offline mode
• Cloud synchronization
• Opening books
• Endgame tablebases

🏆 Achievements & Leaderboards
• Unlock 20+ achievements
• Global leaderboards by rating
• Weekly rankings
• Monthly challenges
• Time control rankings (Blitz, Rapid, Classical)

📖 Educational Content
• Learn chess fundamentals
• Interactive tutorials
• Guided puzzle sequences
• Strategic concepts
• Tactical patterns

🎓 Perfect For
• Beginners learning chess basics
• Intermediate players improving tactics
• Advanced players seeking competition
• Chess enthusiasts worldwide

WHETHER YOU'RE PICKING UP CHESS FOR THE FIRST TIME OR YOU'RE AN EXPERIENCED PLAYER, CHESS TACTICS MASTER HELPS YOU IMPROVE YOUR GAME ONE PUZZLE AT A TIME.
